title: ORSO Uno Espresso Machine
subtitle: Interactive exploded view · concept product

parts.name: Top cover & cup warmer
parts.description: Brushed-steel lid. Heat rising from the boiler warms cups placed on the grill.

parts.name: Left side panel
parts.description: Removable steel side panel for easy servicing.

parts.name: Right side panel
parts.description: Removable steel side panel for easy servicing.

parts.name: Front panel
parts.description: Holds the gauge, buttons and steam knob, and carries the brand badge.

parts.name: Base & rear chassis
parts.description: Rigid frame every component bolts to, with anti-slip feet and the power inlet.

parts.name: Water tank (2 L)
parts.description: Removable rear tank. Lifts out from the top for refilling.

parts.name: Vibration pump
parts.description: Builds the 9 bar of pressure needed to push water through finely ground coffee.

parts.name: Copper water lines
parts.description: Carry water from the tank to the pump, boiler, group head and steam valve.

parts.name: Boiler & heater
parts.description: Stainless boiler with a wrapped heating element. Brings water to about 93 °C for brewing.

parts.name: PID controller
parts.description: Reads the boiler temperature many times a second and keeps it within ±1 °C.

parts.name: 3-way solenoid valve
parts.description: Releases leftover pressure after each shot so the coffee puck comes out dry.

parts.name: Group head
parts.description: Heavy chrome-plated brass head that keeps brew water at a stable temperature.

parts.name: Portafilter
parts.description: Holds the ground coffee. Walnut handle and a double spout for two cups.

parts.name: Pressure gauge
parts.description: Shows brewing pressure live; the green zone marks the ideal 8–11 bar.

parts.name: Controls
parts.description: Brew and steam buttons with status lights, plus the power switch.

parts.name: Steam knob
parts.description: Opens the steam valve. Turn further for more steam power.

parts.name: Steam wand
parts.description: Swivelling chrome wand for frothing milk, with a cool-touch grip.

parts.name: Drip tray
parts.description: Catches drips and the solenoid's water release. Slides out for emptying.

note: Original concept product made for this demo. ORSO is not a real brand; specifications are illustrative.

guide.title: Meet the ORSO Uno
guide.text: A home espresso machine with 18 parts inside. Press Next to take it apart one step at a time.

guide.title: Remove the portafilter and drip tray
guide.text: Twist the portafilter out of the group head and slide the drip tray forward. These come out every day for cleaning.

guide.title: Lift off the top cover
guide.text: The cup-warmer lid lifts straight up. Heat rising from the boiler keeps your cups warm here.

guide.title: Take off the side panels
guide.text: Both steel side panels come away, opening up the inside of the machine.

guide.title: Lift out the water tank
guide.text: The 2-litre tank sits at the back and lifts out from the top for refilling.

guide.title: Open the front
guide.text: The front panel carries the pressure gauge, buttons, steam knob, steam wand and the chrome group head.

guide.title: The heart: the boiler
guide.text: The stainless boiler and its wrapped heater bring the water to about 93 °C for brewing.

guide.title: The water path
guide.text: The vibration pump pushes water through the copper lines at up to 15 bar. The solenoid valve releases pressure after each shot.

guide.title: The brain: the PID controller
guide.text: This board reads the boiler temperature many times a second and keeps it within 1 °C. That's the whole machine, apart. Press Finish to explore freely.
